papers.title: A Longitudinal Disease Progression Model Characterizing Endoscopic Response and Remission in Crohn's Disease
papers.ptype: Clinical Trial, Phase III, Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.authors: Moein A, Langenhorst J, Kassir N
papers.abstract: Crohn's disease (CD) is a heterogeneous, progressive inflammatory bowel disease in which substantial placebo effects often confound assessment of therapeutic efficacy. A placebo-based disease model was developed using Simple Endoscopic Score for Crohn's Disease (SES-CD) within an item-level response theory-bounded integer (IRT-BI) and full random effects models (FREM) framework. Longitudinal SES-CD data from 155 placebo-treated patients in the Phase 3 BERGAMOT-trial were analyzed. Each SES-CD subscore, across five intestinal segments, was described by a bounded-integer model and linked through a latent disease variable capturing a mono-exponential placebo trajectory. Endoscopic response (≥50% reduction from baseline SES-CD) and remission (SES-CD 0-2) were defined according to the FDA guidance. IRT-BI model adequately characterized longitudinal trajectories of all SES-CD subscores and accurately predicted individual patient endoscopic response and remission, with predictive accuracy exceeding 89% for responders and 85% for non-responders. Visual predictive checks showed that observed mean trajectories for all 20 SES-CD subscores were within the 90% confidence intervals across the 66-week trial. Population maximum placebo response (RMaxPL) was estimated at -0.220 with a time to half-maximal effect of 13.8 weeks. Covariate analysis identified elevated baseline C-reactive protein and fecal calprotectin correlated to reduced RMaxPL, whereas TNF-naïve status was associated with increased RMaxPL. This is first application of an integrated item-level IRT-BI-FREM approach in CD, enabling robust characterization of placebo response and identification of clinically relevant covariates. By providing quantitative framework for isolating drug-effects from placebo-response, this model aligns with FDA model-informed drug development priorities and supports efficient, targeted, and informative clinical trials.Clinical Trial RegistrationNCT02394028 Registered March 20, 2015.
papers.title_zh: 克隆氏症內視鏡反應與緩解之縱向疾病進展模型
papers.abstract_zh: 克隆氏症（CD）是一種異質性、進展性的發炎性腸道疾病，其顯著的安慰劑效應常干擾治療效果的評估。本研究利用簡易克隆氏症內視鏡評分（SES-CD），在項目層級反應理論界定整數（IRT-BI）與完整隨機效應模型（FREM）架構下，建立一個以安慰劑為基礎的疾病模型。分析對象為Phase 3 BERGAMOT試驗中155名接受安慰劑治療病人的縱向SES-CD資料。每個SES-CD子分數（涵蓋五個腸段）以界定整數模型描述，並透過一個潛在疾病變數連結，該變數捕捉單指數安慰劑軌跡。內視鏡反應（SES-CD自基線下降≥50%）與緩解（SES-CD 0-2）依FDA指引定義。IRT-BI模型能充分描述所有SES-CD子分數的縱向軌跡，並準確預測個別病人的內視鏡反應與緩解，對有反應者預測準確度超過89%，對無反應者超過85%。視覺化預測檢驗（VPC）顯示，所有20個SES-CD子分數在66週試驗期間之觀察平均軌跡皆落在90%信賴區間內。族群最大安慰劑反應（RMaxPL）估計為-0.220，達半數最大效應時間為13.8週。共變量分析顯示，基線C反應蛋白與糞便鈣衛蛋白升高與較低的RMaxPL相關，而TNF-naïve狀態則與較高的RMaxPL相關。此為首次將整合式項目層級IRT-BI-FREM方法應用於克隆氏症，能穩健描述安慰劑反應並辨識具臨床意義之共變量。此模型提供量化架構以區分藥物效應與安慰劑反應，符合FDA模型導向藥物開發之優先方向，並支持更有效率、更具針對性與資訊性的臨床試驗設計。臨床試驗註冊：NCT02394028，註冊日期2015年3月20日。
papers.score_reason: 方法學嚴謹且為藥物開發模型導向研究，但屬藥物臨床試驗設計工具，與大腸直腸外科臨床決策幾無直接關聯。
papers.relevance_why: 本文為克隆氏症藥物試驗中安慰劑反應之藥動/藥效模型建構，非外科介入亦非直接臨床決策工具。
papers.one_liner: 在BERGAMOT試驗155名安慰劑組克隆氏症病人中，建立IRT-BI-FREM模型預測內視鏡反應，準確度89%（有反應者）/85%（無反應者）。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；此為藥物試驗設計用之統計模型研究，非治療或手術決策依據。

pico.P: BERGAMOT Phase 3試驗中155名接受安慰劑治療之克隆氏症病人
pico.I: IRT-BI結合FREM之疾病進展模型，用於描述SES-CD安慰劑反應軌跡
pico.C: 無對照組（此為模型建構研究，非治療效果比較）
pico.O: 主要：模型對內視鏡反應/緩解之預測準確度；次要：安慰劑反應之最大效應與時間常數、相關共變量

key_numbers: 模型預測有反應者準確度>89%，無反應者準確度>85%
族群最大安慰劑反應RMaxPL為-0.220，達半數最大效應時間13.8週
基線CRP、糞便鈣衛蛋白升高與較低安慰劑反應相關；TNF-naïve與較高安慰劑反應相關
cautions: 本研究僅分析安慰劑組資料，未評估任何藥物之實際療效
主要終點為內視鏡評分（替代指標），非手術/住院/生活品質等硬終點
模型驗證僅為內部VPC，未見獨立世代之外部驗證

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of TAS-102 followed by regorafenib or reverse sequence in later-line treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Sapapsap B, Champarhorm S, Pongpun A, Kanchana N, Tantivit J, Leelakanok N
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Trifluridine/tipiracil (TAS-102) and regorafenib are approved and widely utilized as later-line treatment options for patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). However, the optimal sequence between these agents remains unclear. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to compare the efficacy and safety of two treatment sequences: TAS-102 followed by regorafenib (TR) versus regorafenib followed by TAS-102 (RT) in patients with mCRC who had previously failed chemotherapy.
METHODS: This study was registered with PROSPERO (CRD42024622437). We systematically searched six databases (PubMed, Scopus, CINAHL, ScienceDirect, medRXiv, and OpenGrey) up to June 1, 2025. Risk of bias was assessed using the ROBINS-I tool. Pooled estimates with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using a random-effects model. For studies lacking hazard ratios (HRs), we estimated the HRs using the ratio of median survival times. Publication bias was evaluated with a funnel plot.
RESULTS: Thirteen observational studies with moderate to critical risk of bias were included. No significant difference was found in overall survival (OS) (HR =1.04, 95% CI: 0.86-1.25, I2=72%) or progression-free survival (PFS) (HR =1.34, 95% CI: 0.77-2.34, I2=92%) between the TR and RT groups. The RT group had a higher disease control rate (DCR) (33.1% vs. 28.0%) and tended to have more adverse events (AEs).
CONCLUSIONS: OS and PFS outcomes were comparable between patients treated with TAS-102 followed by regorafenib and those receiving the reverse sequence. Although the RT group was associated with a slightly higher DCR, this was accompanied by a trend toward increased AEs.
papers.title_zh: 轉移性大腸直腸癌後線治療中，TAS-102 序貫 regorafenib 或反向序貫之療效與安全性：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：Trifluridine/tipiracil (TAS-102) 與 regorafenib 皆為經核准且廣泛使用的轉移性大腸直腸癌 (mCRC) 後線治療選項，但兩者最佳使用順序仍不明確。本研究進行系統性回顧與統合分析，比較兩種治療序列：TAS-102 後接 regorafenib (TR) 與 regorafenib 後接 TAS-102 (RT)，在化療失敗之 mCRC 病人中的療效與安全性。

方法：本研究已於 PROSPERO 註冊 (CRD42024622437)。系統性檢索六個資料庫（PubMed、Scopus、CINAHL、ScienceDirect、medRXiv、OpenGrey）至 2025 年 6 月 1 日。使用 ROBINS-I 工具評估偏誤風險。以隨機效應模型計算合併估計值與 95% 信賴區間 (CI)。對於未報告風險比 (HR) 的研究，以中位存活時間之比值估算 HR。以漏斗圖評估發表偏誤。

結果：共納入 13 篇觀察性研究，偏誤風險為中度至極高。TR 組與 RT 組在整體存活期 (OS) (HR=1.04, 95% CI: 0.86–1.25, I²=72%) 或無疾病惡化存活期 (PFS) (HR=1.34, 95% CI: 0.77–2.34, I²=92%) 皆無顯著差異。RT 組疾病控制率 (DCR) 較高 (33.1% vs. 28.0%)，且不良事件 (AE) 有較高之趨勢。

結論：TAS-102 後接 regorafenib 與反向序貫治療之病人，其 OS 與 PFS 表現相當。雖然 RT 組 DCR 略高，但伴隨不良事件增加之趨勢。
papers.score_reason: 納入研究均為觀察性研究且偏誤風險中度至極高、異質性極高（I²達72-92%）、PFS信賴區間極寬幾乎無資訊量，證據力薄弱，僅能作為假說產生，臨床可信度有限。
papers.relevance_why: 後線藥物序貫多由腫瘤內科主導，但涉及mCRC整體治療規劃，對外科醫師之MDT討論仍有參考價值。
papers.one_liner: 在13篇觀察性研究、化療失敗之mCRC病人中，比較TAS-102→regorafenib與反向序貫，OS無差異(HR=1.04)但證據品質偏誤風險高。
papers.action: 目前不需改變臨床用藥順序，仍依病人狀況（如肝功能、預期存活）個別化選擇，待RCT證據出爐再調整。

pico.P: 化療失敗之轉移性大腸直腸癌病人，共13篇觀察性研究合併分析
pico.I: TAS-102 治療後接續使用 regorafenib（TR序貫）
pico.C: Regorafenib 治療後接續使用 TAS-102（RT序貫）
pico.O: 主要：整體存活期(OS)、無疾病惡化存活期(PFS)；次要：疾病控制率(DCR)、不良事件(AE)

key_numbers: PFS無顯著差異：HR=1.34 (95% CI: 0.77–2.34)，但CI極寬、I²=92%，結果不可靠
DCR：RT組33.1% vs. TR組28.0%，絕對差異約5.1%，但未提供統計顯著性檢定
cautions: 全數為觀察性研究（無RCT），ROBINS-I顯示中度至極高偏誤風險，因果推論受限
部分研究缺HR而以中位存活時間比值估算，屬替代性統計方法，可能引入額外偏誤
PFS的I²=92%顯示極高異質性，合併HR之95% CI跨越1且範圍極寬，結果解讀價值低
unassessable: 病人選擇是否受未量測干擾因子影響（confounding by indication）
各研究之隨訪時間長短與異質性來源細節

papers.title: Early and late-onset colorectal cancers: a case-case comparison of risk factors
papers.authors: Rees S, Pearlman R, Paskett E, Shields P, Hampel H, Freudenheim J
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Examine which demographic, lifestyle, and clinical risk factors differ between patients with early-onset colorectal cancers (EOCRC) compared to late-onset colorectal cancers (LOCRC).
METHODS: We conducted a case-case comparison of risk factors and symptoms for EOCRC and LOCRC, utilizing the Ohio Colorectal Cancer Prevention Initiative (OCCPI) data, a statewide study of newly diagnosed CRC among Ohio residents, aged 20-92 years. Unconditional logistic regression (odds ratios (OR) and 95% confidence intervals (CI)) was used to compare risk factors by age-at-diagnoses; those diagnosed < 50 years (EOCRC, N = 288) compared to those diagnosed ≥ 50 years (LOCRC, N = 1,018), adjusting for sex, race/ethnicity, education, smoking status, and family history of CRC.
RESULTS: Compared to LOCRC, EOCRC cases had higher odds of ever consuming alcohol (OR = 2.47, CI: 1.55-3.91), consuming more alcohol in their teens/twenties than in other decades (OR = 1.85, CI: 1.36-2.51), and binge drinking (OR = 3.15, CI: 2.31-4.30). EOCRC cases were more likely to have Lynch syndrome (OR = 4.61, CI: 2.72-7.84), and report experiencing pre-diagnostic CRC symptoms (OR = 6.08, CI: 3.77-9.82), including blood in stool (52.3 vs. 30.7%), change in bowel habits (37.2 vs. 19.8%), and bowel obstruction (13.9 vs. 7.7%). Birth weight, inflammatory bowel disease, irritable bowel syndrome, and sex did not differ by age-at-diagnosis. However, when birthweight was compared between the youngest EOCRC to the oldest LOCRC cases (< 40 vs. ≥ 65 years), odds of birthweight of < 6lbs was higher in the youngest cases (OR: 2.15, CI: 0.95-4.87).
CONCLUSION: Alcohol consumption, consuming the most alcohol in one's teens/twenties, binge drinking, having Lynch syndrome, and pre-diagnostic CRC symptoms were more associated with EOCRC than LOCRC.
papers.title_zh: 早發型與晚發型大腸直腸癌之危險因子病例對病例比較研究
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：探討早發型大腸直腸癌（EOCRC）與晚發型大腸直腸癌（LOCRC）患者在人口學、生活習慣及臨床危險因子上的差異。方法：本研究利用Ohio Colorectal Cancer Prevention Initiative（OCCPI）資料，針對俄亥俄州20-92歲新診斷大腸直腸癌居民，進行危險因子與症狀的病例對病例比較。以非條件式邏輯回歸（勝算比OR及95%信賴區間CI）比較診斷年齡<50歲者（EOCRC，N=288）與≥50歲者（LOCRC，N=1,018），並調整性別、種族/族裔、教育程度、吸菸狀態及大腸直腸癌家族史。結果：相較於LOCRC，EOCRC病例有較高勝算曾飲酒（OR=2.47，CI:1.55-3.91）、在青少年/二十多歲時飲酒量高於其他年齡段（OR=1.85，CI:1.36-2.51）、以及暴飲（OR=3.15，CI:2.31-4.30）。EOCRC病例更可能罹患Lynch症候群（OR=4.61，CI:2.72-7.84），並更常報告診斷前出現大腸直腸癌症狀（OR=6.08，CI:3.77-9.82），包括血便（52.3% vs. 30.7%）、排便習慣改變（37.2% vs. 19.8%）及腸阻塞（13.9% vs. 7.7%）。出生體重、發炎性腸道疾病、腸躲激症及性別在不同診斷年齡組間無差異。然而，當比較最年輕的EOCRC與最年長的LOCRC病例（<40歲 vs. ≥65歲）時，最年輕病例出生體重<6磅的勝算較高（OR:2.15，CI:0.95-4.87）。結論：飲酒、青少年/二十多歲時飲酒量最高、暴飲、罹患Lynch症候群，以及診斷前症狀，與EOCRC的關聯性較LOCRC更高。
papers.score_reason: 州級登記資料樣本尚可，但為病例對病例設計無健康對照組，且飲酒/症狀皆為回溯自述，美國人群結果對台灣外推性有限。
papers.relevance_why: EOCRC是當前熱門臨床議題，症狀學發現有參考價值，但美國族群飲酒文化與Lynch症候群盛行率與台灣不同，直接套用需謹慎。
papers.one_liner: 在俄亥俄州1,306名大腸直腸癌患者中，比較EOCRC（N=288）與LOCRC（N=1,018），發現飲酒、暴飲、Lynch症候群、診斷前症狀皆與EOCRC顯著相關（OR最高6.08）。
papers.action: 對<50歲出現血便、排便習慣改變的病人應提高警覺並詢問飲酒史與家族史，及早安排大腸鏡評估Lynch症候群可能性。

pico.P: 俄亥俄州新診斷大腸直腸癌患者共1,306人（EOCRC N=288，年齡<50歲；LOCRC N=1,018，年齡≥50歲）
pico.I: 早發型大腸直腸癌（診斷年齡<50歲）
pico.C: 晚發型大腸直腸癌（診斷年齡≥50歲）
pico.O: 主要outcome：人口學、生活習慣（飲酒、吸菸）、臨床危險因子（Lynch症候群、IBD、IBS、出生體重）及診斷前症狀之勝算比差異；次要：症狀類型（血便、排便習慣改變、腸阻塞）發生率

key_numbers: 血便症狀：EOCRC 52.3% vs LOCRC 30.7%，差異約21.6個百分點
Lynch症候群：EOCRC相對LOCRC勝算比OR=4.61（95% CI: 2.72-7.84）
暴飲行為：EOCRC相對LOCRC勝算比OR=3.15（95% CI: 2.31-4.30）
cautions: 病例對病例設計無健康對照組，僅反映兩年齡組間相對差異，無法估算絕對發病風險
飲酒史與症狀均為診斷後回溯自述，易受回憶偏誤及回憶不對等影響（recall bias）
美國俄亥俄州人群之種族結構、飲酒文化與遺傳背景與台灣族群差異大，外推性有限

papers.title: Risk of Infections With Infliximab vs Adalimumab Among Children With Inflammatory Bowel Disease
papers.authors: Lyu N, Tracy M, Schneeweiss S, Savage T
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Infliximab and adalimumab are the only biologics approved by the US Food and Drug Administration for use in children with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The comparative infection risks between infliximab and adalimumab have not been evaluated in clinical settings.
OBJECTIVE: To compare the risk of infections with infliximab vs adalimumab among pediatric patients with IBD using nationwide claims data.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cohort study used data from 2 nationwide health care claims databases from January 1, 2016, to February 28, 2025. The study included children and adolescents aged 6 to 17 years with a diagnosis of Crohn disease or ulcerative colitis who newly initiated infliximab or adalimumab and had 180 days or more of prior continuous enrollment.
EXPOSURES: Initiation of adalimumab vs infliximab.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Serious infections were defined as infections requiring hospitalization, using a validated algorithm. Outpatient infections were defined as an outpatient infection diagnosis with a targeted antimicrobial dispensed within 1 day. Baseline covariates within each dataset were balanced with 1:1 propensity score matching and results were pooled using fixed effects meta-analysis. Incidence rates and hazard ratios (HRs) were estimated over a 180-day follow-up.
RESULTS: After applying exclusion criteria, 4239 children with IBD initiating infliximab (2467; mean [SD] age, 13.3 [2.9] years; 1462 boys [59.3%]; 1502 with Crohn disease [60.9%]) or adalimumab (1772; mean [SD] age, 14.0 [2.7] years; 1047 boys [59.1%]; 1068 with Crohn disease [60.3%]) were identified. After matching, each exposure group included 1533 patients. The incidence of serious infections was 29 per 1000 person-years for infliximab (reference) and 34 per 1000 person-years for adalimumab (pooled HR, 1.15; 95% CI, 0.63-2.11). Outpatient infections were more common, with rates of 358 per 1000 person-years for infliximab and 386 per 1000 person-years for adalimumab (pooled HR, 1.08; 95% CI, 0.90-1.29). Results of sensitivity analyses, including restriction to monotherapy, originator-only use, first-line users only, exclusion of gastrointestinal infections from the outcome, and extending follow-up to 365 days, were all consistent with the primary findings. No mycobacterial infections were observed in the overall cohort.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this cohort study of children and adolescents with IBD, serious infections were rare. No evidence of differences in infection risk were observed between infliximab and adalimumab. These findings suggest that the 2 agents may have comparable infection risk profiles in pediatric IBD, although meaningful differences cannot be ruled out.
papers.title_zh: 兒童發炎性腸道疾病病人使用Infliximab與Adalimumab之感染風險比較
papers.abstract_zh: 重要性：Infliximab與adalimumab是美國食品藥物管理局唯二核准用於兒童發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）的生物製劑。兩者在臨床情境下的感染風險比較尚未被評估。目的：利用全國性理賠資料比較兒童IBD病人使用infliximab與adalimumab之感染風險。設計、場域與參與者：本世代研究使用2016年1月1日至2025年2月28日兩個全國性醫療理賠資料庫。納入6至17歲診斷為克隆氏症或潰瘍性結腸炎、新起始使用infliximab或adalimumab、且先前持續加保180天以上之兒童與青少年。暴露：起始使用adalimumab相對於infliximab。主要結果與測量：嚴重感染定義為使用經驗證演算法判定需住院之感染。門診感染定義為門診感染診斷合併1天內開立targeted抗微生物藥物。以1:1傾向分數配對平衡各資料庫內之基準共變項，並以固定效應統合分析合併結果。以180天追蹤估計發生率與風險比（HR）。結果：套用排除條件後，共識別4239名起始infliximab（2467人；平均[SD]年齡13.3[2.9]歲；男孩1462人[59.3%]；克隆氏症1502人[60.9%]）或adalimumab（1772人；平均[SD]年齡14.0[2.7]歲；男孩1047人[59.1%]；克隆氏症1068人[60.3%]）之IBD兒童。配對後每組各1533名病人。嚴重感染發生率為infliximab每1000人年29例（參照組），adalimumab每1000人年34例（合併HR，1.15；95% CI，0.63-2.11）。門診感染較常見，infliximab每1000人年358例，adalimumab每1000人年386例（合併HR，1.08；95% CI，0.90-1.29）。敏感度分析結果，包括限制於單一藥物治療、僅原廠藥使用、僅第一線使用者、排除胃腸道感染作為結果、以及延長追蹤至365天，皆與主要發現一致。整體世代中未觀察到分枝桿菌感染。結論與相關性：在此兒童與青少年IBD世代研究中，嚴重感染罕見。未觀察到infliximab與adalimumab感染風險有差異之證據。此發現顯示兩種藥物在兒童IBD中可能具有相當的感染風險側寫，惟無法排除具臨床意義之差異存在。
papers.score_reason: 方法嚴謹（全國理賠資料、傾向分數配對、統合分析），但研究對象為兒科IBD生物製劑用藥安全性，非手術介入，對台灣大腸直腸外科臨床決策幾無直接參考價值。
papers.relevance_why: 本文為兒童IBD內科生物製劑感染風險比較，非外科介入亦非成人大腸直腸手術族群。
papers.one_liner: 在4239名兒童IBD病人中，比較infliximab與adalimumab起始治療，嚴重感染率29 vs 34/1000人年無顯著差異（HR 1.15，95% CI 0.63-2.11）。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法：此為兒科腸胃科用藥安全性研究，與大腸直腸外科手術決策無直接關聯。

pico.P: 6-17歲新起始infliximab或adalimumab之兒童IBD病人，配對後每組1533人（原始共4239人）
pico.O: 主要：需住院之嚴重感染；次要：門診感染（合併targeted抗微生物藥物開立）

key_numbers: 嚴重感染：29 vs 34/1000人年，HR 1.15（95% CI 0.63-2.11），CI寬且跨1，無法排除臨床意義差異
整體世代未觀察到任何分枝桿菌感染
cautions: 嚴重感染HR之95% CI高達0.63-2.11，樣本數/事件數可能不足以偵測有意義差異，「無差異」結論需謹慎
主要追蹤僅180天（延長至365天為敏感度分析），無法評估長期感染風險

papers.title: Comparison of compound methylene blue (methylene blue + ropivacaine) and bupivacaine liposome for pain control after mixed hemorrhoid surgery: A comprehensive analysis based on clinical studies
papers.authors: Mai G, Yu J, Li J
papers.abstract: BackgroundEffective pain management is critical following hemorrhoidectomy due to the dense nerve distribution in the anorectal region. Although compound methylene blue and liposomal bupivacaine are both used for postoperative analgesia, their comparative efficacy and safety profiles have not been systematically evaluated. This study aimed to compare the analgesic efficacy, opioid-sparing effects, and safety of liposomal bupivacaine with compound methylene blue in patients undergoing mixed hemorrhoidectomy.MethodsThis was a single-center, prospective observational cohort study involving 150 patients undergoing elective hemorrhoidectomy for stage III-IV mixed hemorrhoids. Patients were allocated into two groups: (a) the compound methylene blue group (n = 75) and (b) the liposomal bupivacaine group (n = 75). Postoperative pain was assessed using the numerical rating scale at rest over 72 h. Primary outcomes included cumulative pain scores, time to first rescue analgesia, and total rescue opioid consumption. Secondary outcomes included patient satisfaction, recovery metrics, and adverse events.ResultsThe liposomal bupivacaine group demonstrated significantly lower cumulative pain scores over 72 h than the compound methylene blue group. Although the compound methylene blue group demonstrated marginally better pain control in the immediate postoperative period, liposomal bupivacaine provided superior and stable analgesia from 12 to 72 h. The proportion of patients who required rescue opioids was significantly lower in the liposomal bupivacaine group than in the compound methylene blue group. Patient satisfaction was significantly higher in the liposomal bupivacaine group. Furthermore, the incidence of adverse events was significantly lower in the liposomal bupivacaine group than in the compound methylene blue group.ConclusionsSingle-dose perianal infiltration of liposomal bupivacaine provides superior and more sustained postoperative analgesia than that of compound methylene blue in patients who have undergone mixed hemorrhoidectomy. Liposomal bupivacaine significantly reduces rescue opioid requirements, delays the need for supplemental analgesia, and improves patient satisfaction with a favorable safety profile.
papers.title_zh: 複方亞甲藍（亞甲藍+羅哌卡因）與脂質體布比卡因用於混合痔手術後疼痛控制之比較：基於臨床研究的綜合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：由於肛門直腸區域神經分布密集，痔切除術後有效的疼痛管理至關重要。雖然複方亞甲藍與脂質體布比卡因皆用於術後止痛，但兩者的療效與安全性比較尚未經系統性評估。本研究旨在比較脂質體布比卡因與複方亞甲藍在接受混合痔切除術患者中的鎮痛療效、減少類鴉片使用效果及安全性。方法：這是一項單中心、前瞻性觀察性世代研究，納入150名因第III-IV期混合痔接受選擇性痔切除術的患者。患者被分配至兩組：(a) 複方亞甲藍組（n=75）與(b) 脂質體布比卡因組（n=75）。術後疼痛以數字評分量表於休息狀態下評估72小時。主要結果包括累積疼痛評分、首次需要急救鎮痛的時間、以及類鴉片急救藥物總使用量。次要結果包括病患滿意度、恢復指標及不良事件。結果：脂質體布比卡因組在72小時內的累積疼痛評分顯著低於複方亞甲藍組。雖然複方亞甲藍組在術後即刻期間的疼痛控制稍佳，但脂質體布比卡因在12至72小時提供更優越且穩定的鎮痛效果。需要類鴉片急救藥物的患者比例在脂質體布比卡因組顯著較低。病患滿意度在脂質體布比卡因組顯著較高。此外，脂質體布比卡因組的不良事件發生率顯著低於複方亞甲藍組。結論：單次劑量肛周浸潤脂質體布比卡因在接受混合痔切除術的患者中，提供比複方亞甲藍更優越且持久的術後鎮痛效果。脂質體布比卡因顯著減少類鴉片急救藥物需求、延遲補充鎮痛需求時間，並在良好的安全性下提升病患滿意度。
papers.score_reason: 非隨機分配的觀察性世代研究，摘要完全未提供任何絕對數值或p值，僅以「顯著」描述，證據強度與可判讀性皆有限。
papers.relevance_why: 痔切除術後疼痛控制為大腸直腸外科日常議題，但脂質體布比卡因（Exparel）在台灣尚未普及使用，實務可轉移性受限。

papers.action: 目前不需改變做法：此藥物於台灣未廣泛可得，且研究設計非隨機、摘要無絕對數值，證據不足以更動現行痔切除術後止痛方案。

pico.I: 肛周浸潤脂質體布比卡因（單次劑量）
pico.C: 複方亞甲藍（亞甲藍+羅哌卡因）肛周浸潤
pico.O: 主要：72小時累積疼痛評分、首次急救鎮痛時間、類鴉片急救藥物總消耗量；次要：病患滿意度、恢復指標、不良事件

papers.title: Clinical value of wide-angle colonoscopy combined with narrow-band imaging in detecting sessile serrated lesions during colorectal cancer screening: A single-center retrospective observational study
papers.authors: Liu B, Wang H, Li L, Huang X, Hou L
papers.abstract: Sessile serrated lesions (SSLs) represent a clinically significant challenge in colorectal cancer screening due to their flat morphology and association with interval cancers. Advanced endoscopic techniques such as wide-angle colonoscopy (WAC) and narrow-band imaging (NBI) may enhance detection rates of SLs, but evidence regarding their combined efficacy remains limited. This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of WAC combined with NBI in detecting SSLs compared to NBI alone and standard white-light endoscopy (WLE) during colorectal cancer (CRC) screening. In this single-center retrospective observational cohort study, the clinical records of 342 eligible patients who underwent CRC screening at Rongchang District Hospital between January 4, 2024, and January 31, 2025, were reviewed. Data were extracted from the Epic-Hyperspace electronic medical record system and institutional endoscopy/pathology records. Patients were categorized according to the imaging strategy documented during colonoscopy: WAC + NBI, full procedure with 170° view and NBI, n = 114; WLE + NBI, white-light examination with selective NBI activation, n = 114; or WLE + WAC, 170° wide-angle without NBI, n = 114. The primary outcome was sessile serrated lesion detection rate. Endoscopic procedures were performed using Olympus 290 systems. Histopathological diagnosis was conducted by pathologists blinded to the imaging group. In unadjusted comparisons, the WAC + NBI group had a higher sessile serrated lesion detection rate (18.4%) than both the WLE + NBI group (11.4%, P < .05, and the WLE + WAC group (7.9%, P < .05. No significant differences were observed in most secondary outcomes. The exploratory adenoma miss rate in a 10% subsample was numerically lower in WAC + NBI (11.1%) than in WLE + WAC (27.8%, P > .05. Procedurally, WAC + NBI required longer withdrawal times (9.3 ± 1.5 minutes) than comparator groups (8.0-8.1 minutes, P < .05. The combination of WAC and NBI may offer clinical advantages in improving SSL detection during CRC screening. These findings could support broader adoption of advanced endoscopic technologies in population-based screening programs. These findings should be interpreted cautiously and validated in prospective multicenter studies.
papers.title_zh: 廣角大腸鏡結合窄頻影像在大腸直腸癌篩檢中偵測無蒂鋸齒狀病灶的臨床價值：單中心回溯性觀察研究
papers.abstract_zh: 無蒂鋸齒狀病灶（SSLs）因其扁平型態及與間隔癌的關聯，在大腸直腸癌篩檢中構成臨床上重大挑戰。廣角大腸鏡（WAC）與窄頻影像（NBI）等進階內視鏡技術可能提升SSL偵測率，但兩者合併使用之療效證據仍有限。本研究旨在評估WAC結合NBI相較於單獨使用NBI以及標準白光內視鏡（WLE）在大腸直腸癌（CRC）篩檢中偵測SSL的效果。本單中心回溯性觀察性世代研究回顧了2024年1月4日至2025年1月31日於Rongchang區醫院接受CRC篩檢之342名符合條件病患的臨床紀錄。資料取自Epic-Hyperspace電子病歷系統以及院內內視鏡/病理紀錄。病患依大腸鏡檢查時記錄之影像策略分組：WAC+NBI組（全程170°視野加NBI，n=114）、WLE+NBI組（白光檢查搭配選擇性啟動NBI，n=114）、或WLE+WAC組（170°廣角但無NBI，n=114）。主要結果為無蒂鋸齒狀病灶偵測率。內視鏡操作使用Olympus 290系統。組織病理診斷由對影像分組不知情的病理醫師進行。在未調整比較中，WAC+NBI組之SSL偵測率（18.4%）高於WLE+NBI組（11.4%，P < .05）及WLE+WAC組（7.9%，P < .05）。大多數次要結果未觀察到顯著差異。在10%子樣本中進行的探索性腺瘤漏診率分析顯示，WAC+NBI組（11.1%）數值上低於WLE+WAC組（27.8%，P > .05）。程序方面，WAC+NBI組所需退鏡時間（9.3 ± 1.5分鐘）較對照組（8.0-8.1分鐘）長，P < .05。WAC與NBI合併使用可能在CRC篩檢中改善SSL偵測率具有臨床優勢。此發現可能支持在人群篩檢計畫中更廣泛採用進階內視鏡技術。然而這些結果應謹慎解讀，並需在前瞻性多中心研究中進一步驗證。

papers.relevance_why: 台灣部分大腸直腸外科醫師執行篩檢性大腸鏡，SSL偵測技術與臨床相關，但本研究非手術介入。

pico.O: 主要：SSL偵測率；次要：腺瘤漏診率（10%子樣本）、退鏡時間

papers.title: Evaluation of sleep, fatigue, and quality of life in patients with primary immunodeficiency
papers.authors: Kalkan F, Yeşillik S, Demirel F, Sönmez E, Selçuk A, Balaban Y
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Primary immunodeficiency (PID) is a heterogeneous group of genetic disorders characterized by recurrent infections and immune dysregulation. Despite advances in therapy, many patients experience impaired quality of life (QoL), fatigue, and sleep disturbances. This study aimed to evaluate sleep quality, fatigue, and health-related QoL in adults with PID and to explore the associations between comorbidities and treatment modalities.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective, observational, single-center study was conducted at the University of Health Sciences, Gülhane Training and Research Hospital between May and August 2024. Forty-nine adult patients with PID, diagnosed according to international criteria, completed validated questionnaires: the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), Fatigue Severity Scale (FSS), and SF-36 QoL scale. Clinical and demographic data were retrieved from the medical records. Statistical analyses included t-tests, Mann-Whitney U, chi-square, and Pearson's correlation, with significance set at P < 0.05.
RESULTS: Of 49 patients (55.1% males, mean follow-up 9.9 years), 36.7% had poor sleep quality, 42.9% reported severe fatigue, 49% showed impaired SF-36 physical scores, and 87.8% had preserved mental scores. Poor sleep quality was correlated positively with fatigue (r = 0.623, P < 0.001) and negatively correlated with physical QoL (r = -0.491, P < 0.001). Patients with autoimmune and inflammatory bowel disease had significantly worse PSQI and FSS scores, whereas bronchiectasis was associated with reduced SF-36 physical scores. No differences were observed between the IVIG and SCIG groups in fatigue or mental scores; however, SCIG recipients had significantly higher physical scores (P = 0.018).
CONCLUSION: Patients with PID experience substantial impairment in physical QoL, with fatigue and poor sleep quality frequently coexisting. Comorbidities, such as autoimmunity, bronchiectasis, and inflammatory bowel disease, exacerbate these impairments. SCIG therapy confers better physical outcomes than IVIG therapy. Comprehensive care strategies that address psychosocial and physical health are essential for the management of PID.
papers.title_zh: 評估原發性免疫缺陷病患的睡眠、疲勞與生活品質
papers.abstract_zh:
前言：原發性免疫缺陷（PID）是一群異質性的遺傳性疾病，特徵為反覆感染與免疫失調。儘管治療已有進展，許多病患仍經歷生活品質（QoL）受損、疲勞與睡眠障礙。本研究旨在評估PID成人病患的睡眠品質、疲勞與健康相關生活品質，並探討共病症與治療方式之間的關聯。

材料與方法：本回溯性、觀察性、單一中心研究於2024年5月至8月間在Gülhane健康科學大學訓練與研究醫院進行。49名依國際標準診斷為PID的成人病患完成經驗證之問卷：匹茲堡睡眠品質指數（PSQI）、疲勞嚴重度量表（FSS）與SF-36生活品質量表。臨床與人口學資料取自病歷紀錄。統計分析包括t檢定、Mann-Whitney U檢定、卡方檢定與Pearson相關分析，顯著性設為P < 0.05。

結果：49名病患中（55.1%為男性，平均追蹤9.9年），36.7%睡眠品質差，42.9%回報重度疲勞，49%SF-36生理分數受損，87.8%心理分數維持良好。睡眠品質差與疲勞呈正相關（r = 0.623，P < 0.001），與生理QoL呈負相關（r = -0.491，P < 0.001）。合併自體免疫疾病與發炎性腸道疾病的病患，其PSQI與FSS分數顯著較差，而支氣管擴張症則與SF-36生理分數降低相關。IVIG與SCIG組間在疲勞或心理分數上無差異，然而SCIG接受者的生理分數顯著較高（P = 0.018）。

結論：PID病患在生理生活品質上有顯著受損，疲勞與睡眠品質差經常並存。共病症如自體免疫、支氣管擴張症與發炎性腸道疾病會加劇此類受損。SCIG治療較IVIG治療帶來更佳的生理預後。針對PID的完整照護策略應同時處理心理社會與生理健康層面。

papers.title: Research trends and hotspots of postoperative ileus in patients with colorectal cancer: A bibliometric analysis (1992-2024)
papers.authors: Wang K, Yi C, Chen Y, Xiao S, Shu Y, Wang J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer is the third most prevalent cancer and the second leading cause of cancer mortality worldwide. Surgery is the primary treatment for early-stage colorectal cancer. Postoperative ileus is a common complication following colorectal surgery.
METHODS: A comprehensive literature search was conducted for the period from 1992 to 2024 using the Web of Science Core Collection. Bibliometric tools, including VOSviewer, CiteSpace, and R package "Bibliometrix," were employed for bibliometric and visual analysis of relevant literature.
RESULTS: This study analyzed 334 publications on postoperative ileus in colorectal cancer. Publications increased sharply from the mid-2000s, peaking at 37 in 2021. China contributed the most corresponding-author publications (n = 80), while publications involving authors from the United States received the highest number of citations (1713). "Laparoscopy" and "enhanced recovery" were the most frequent keywords, with recent heightened focus on "anastomotic leakage" and "enhanced recovery."
CONCLUSION: This bibliometric analysis maps the evolution of research on postoperative ileus in colorectal cancer from 1992 to 2024. The literature has shifted from surgical techniques toward enhanced recovery and complication management, with recent foci on prolonged postoperative ileus and anastomotic leakage. These trends suggest that future studies may benefit from clearer risk stratification, standardized definitions, and multicenter validation within the context of enhanced recovery after surgery pathways.
papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌病人術後腸阻塞之研究趨勢與熱點：文獻計量學分析（1992-2024）
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：大腸直腸癌為全球第三常見癌症，也是癌症死亡率第二高的原因。手術是早期大腸直腸癌的主要治療方式。術後腸阻塞是大腸直腸手術後常見的併發症。方法：使用Web of Science核心合輯，針對1992年至2024年間的文獻進行全面性文獻搜尋。採用VOSviewer、CiteSpace及R套件「Bibliometrix」等文獻計量工具，對相關文獻進行文獻計量學與視覺化分析。結果：本研究共分析334篇關於大腸直腸癌術後腸阻塞之出版品。出版數量自2000年代中期起急遽增加，於2021年達到高峰（37篇）。中國以通訊作者身分貢獻最多出版品（n=80），而美國作者參與之出版品獲得最高引用次數（1713次）。「腹腔鏡」與「加速康復」為最常見的關鍵字，近期則對「吻合口滲漏」與「加速康復」的關注度提高。結論：本文獻計量分析描繪了1992年至2024年間大腸直腸癌術後腸阻塞研究之演變。文獻焦點已從手術技術轉向加速康復與併發症管理，近期焦點集中於延長性術後腸阻塞與吻合口滲漏。這些趨勢顯示未來研究可能受益於更清晰的風險分層、標準化定義，以及在加速術後康復（ERAS）路徑背景下的多中心驗證。

papers.title: Colorectal cancer landscape from gut microbiota: Insights into mutations, epigenetic dysregulation, and immune microenvironment alterations
papers.authors: Li Y, Yang Y, Zhang X, Huang Z, Zhang X, Wen J
papers.abstract: This review explores how gut microbiota reshapes colorectal cancer (CRC) molecular landscape, driving initiation/progression via key mechanisms. Microbes/metabolites cause driver mutations (DNA damage, signaling interference) and alter epigenetics (DNA methylation, histone modifications, ncRNAs) to boost tumor cell proliferation/survival. Dysbiosis disrupts tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) by impairing immune cells and increasing immunosuppressive factors, fostering immune evasion.Integrating molecular biology, microbiology, and immunology, we show microbial changes are causal in oncogenesis, with species acting distinctly across tumor stages. These insights clarify CRC pathogenesis and support microbiota-based prevention, diagnosis, treatment. Targeting microbes/metabolites or signaling pathways could cut CRC risk, improve early detection, and boost therapy. The review highlights microbiota-targeted therapy's promise and guides future research/clinical translation.
papers.title_zh: 腸道菌叢視角下的大腸直腸癌全貌：基因突變、表觀遺傳失調與免疫微環境改變之洞察
papers.abstract_zh: 本綜述探討腸道菌叢如何重塑大腸直腸癌（CRC）的分子全貌，透過關鍵機制驅動腫瘤的發生與進展。微生物及其代謝產物會造成驅動基因突變（DNA損傷、訊息傳導干擾），並改變表觀遺傳（DNA甲基化、組蛋白修飾、非編碼RNA），以促進腫瘤細胞增殖與存活。菌叢失衡（dysbiosis）會破壞腫瘤免疫微環境（TIME），損害免疫細胞功能並增加免疫抑制因子，助長免疫逃逸。整合分子生物學、微生物學與免疫學，我們顯示微生物變化在腫瘤發生中具有因果角色，且不同菌種在腫瘤各分期中作用各異。這些洞察有助釐清CRC致病機轉，並支持以菌叢為基礎的預防、診斷與治療。針對微生物、其代謝產物或訊息傳導路徑進行標的治療，可望降低CRC風險、提升早期偵測率並增強治療效果。本綜述強調菌叢標的治療的潛力，並為未來研究與臨床轉譯提供方向。

papers.title: From copper imbalance to immunometabolic remodeling: cuproptosis-related vulnerability and therapeutic hypotheses in autoimmune diseases
papers.authors: Shao Y, Zhang R, Wang Z, Gan J, Jiang X, Yang L
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Autoimmune diseases (AIDs) are characterized by disrupted immune tolerance, chronic inflammation, and organ-specific tissue injury. Their pathogenesis involves the interplay between genetic susceptibility and environmental factors. Although current biological agents and glucocorticoid therapies have improved clinical outcomes, long-term remission rates remain limited, with persistent risks including infection, organ toxicity, and immunogenicity. Emerging evidence indicates that copper homeostasis imbalance, mitochondrial dysfunction, redox stress, and immunometabolic remodeling coexist in multiple systemic and organ-specific AIDs. Cuproptosis, a newly identified form of regulated cell death, provides a potential mechanistic framework to understand the convergence of these pathological processes. However, direct in vivo evidence of canonical cuproptosis in autoimmune lesions remains scarce, and most relevant studies rely on transcriptomic associations, public dataset mining, or model-dependent experiments. There is an urgent need to clarify conceptual boundaries and the hierarchy of evidence.
OBJECTIVES: This review aims to systematically distinguish the conceptual differences among copper dysregulation, copper-associated mitochondrial/redox stress, cuproptosis-related vulnerability, and canonical cuproptosis. It seeks to summarize the hierarchical levels and limitations of existing evidence, evaluate the translational potential of copper-modulating strategies in AIDs, and provide references for future research directions and clinical translation.
RESULTS: 1. A hierarchical evidence grading system for cuproptosis was established, categorizing existing evidence into six levels: bioinformatic inference (e.g., transcriptomic differential expression, immune infiltration correlation), disease-associated phenotypic evidence, functional perturbation evidence, rescue-based evidence, direct biochemical validation, and in vivo disease validation. It was clarified that canonical cuproptosis can only be confirmed when copper dependence, involvement of the Ferredoxin 1 (FDX1)-lipoylation axis, aggregation of lipoylated proteins, destabilization of Fe-S clusters, and functional rescue are demonstrated. 2. The characteristics of copper metabolism disorders and cuproptosis related molecular remodeling in systemic AIDs (e.g., systemic lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis) and organ-specific AIDs (e.g., inflammatory bowel disease, ankylosing spondylitis) were summarized. Findings mostly reflected copper-associated metabolic stress or susceptibility markers rather than definitive functional activation. 3. The immunometabolic regulatory roles of cuproptosis in immune cells-including macrophages, dendritic cells, and T cells-were analyzed, highlighting that their effects are cell-type and context dependent. 4. The limitations of copper-modulating strategies, such as copper chelators and copper ionophores, were evaluated, emphasizing that these currently represent hypothesis-generating approaches. Clinical application requires consideration of toxicity, targeting specificity, pharmacokinetics, and disease-context dependence.
CONCLUSIONS: Current research on cuproptosis in AIDs is largely correlative, bioinformatic, or model dependent, and is insufficient to confirm canonical cuproptosis as a primary pathogenic mechanism in AIDs. Cuproptosis should be regarded as a conditional and hypothesis-generating framework. Future studies should adopt a rigorous evidence hierarchy, optimize diseaserelevant model selection, and validate its pathophysiological significance through direct biochemical assays. The clinical translation of copper-targeted therapeutic strategies still requires substantial foundational and clinical research support.
